resources.string: The accessibility service detects remote key presses and when the original Home screen opens so it can show SeeClap Launcher or open SeeClap. It does not read screen content. This information stays on the TV.

For personal use on your own devices. Keep SeeClap first. Changing, redistributing or deploying the launcher for others requires written permission. See LICENSE.
Other people\'s work used by the Home screen.
Home and remote button handling is based on CleanYourTV, © 2026 Gathin, under the MIT licence.
The TV asks “Allow debugging?”: tick “Always allow”, then OK.
On the TV: Settings › System › About, press “Build” 7 times. Then in Developer options, turn on “USB debugging” (and “Network debugging” if there is one). Then come back and try again.

Debugging is on, but this TV only opens it to a computer (recent Google TV devices do this). From a computer on the same Wi-Fi, run “adb tcpip 5555” once, then Try again — repeat after each TV restart. Or use the AI kit from the website, which does the whole clean-up from the computer.
You can re-enable disabled apps in Settings › Clean up. Cleared caches cannot be restored.
Choose the ones you never use. Apps the TV needs are not listed.
Some operations could not be completed.
Browse the previews, then confirm your choice. Automatic follows your TV’s theme.
SeeClap Launcher replaces your TV\'s Home screen: simple, fast and beautiful. A few settings, and you\'re done.
SeeClap installs from your TV\'s store and updates itself there.
Your TV has no Google Play. SeeClap downloads from its official website, with no other app to install, and its updates arrive on their own.
It always stays first among your favorites.
Choose up to %d apps next to SeeClap. You can change them later.
The remote\'s Home button now opens SeeClap Launcher.
If your TV cannot change its Home app, open SeeClap Launcher from your apps.
Android will ask which Home screen to use: choose SeeClap Launcher.
On this TV, Google keeps the Home button. An Android setting lets SeeClap Launcher take it back.
1. Press “Open Accessibility”.\n2. Choose “SeeClap Launcher – Home button”.\n3. Turn it on: you come back here on your own.
“%s” already holds the Home button: on the same page, turn it off first.
Two apps hold the Home button

Not turned on yet. Try again, or choose “Later”.
If Android restricts this setting, check the app info for SeeClap Launcher or choose Later.
Press the remote button that should open SeeClap, for example YouTube or Netflix. A long press will still open the original app.
Google TV Streamer remote: the star button can also be set in the TV\'s settings.
